title: TUNEXX Is Billboard’s K-Pop Up & Comer of the Month for October: Exclusive Photos
summary: Ready to make fresh waves in the global music scene through constant experimentation, TUNEXX share their story in their own words.
contentText:
Having moved past the dazzling first steps of their debut, TUNEXX are now writing their own story in deeper, more mature shades. Back with their second mini album ‘BLUE MODE,’ the group has etched the sincerity of “us” throughout the record, opening a new chapter as artists. Wrapped in a sentimental “blue” mood, the album also marks another starting point, one where the members tune into the same frequency as their fans.

The new album bears the marks of the members’ intense deliberation from start to finish. Led by Donggyu, the members put their heads together to create the most TUNEXX-like choreography yet, while Zeon, Sihwan, Inhu and Taira breathed life into the album by writing lyrics and crafting raps themselves. Everyday inspirations, from words murmured on a rainy day to a flower tended with care, grew into a message of connection that reaches beyond “me” and “you,” and took shape as heartfelt lyrics.

The essence of being “TUNEXX-like,” as the group defines it for themselves, lies in captivating contrast and total immersion. Their music is easy to enjoy anywhere in everyday life, yet on stage they command attention with sheer intensity, through finely controlled pacing and razor-sharp choreography. Rather than confining themselves to a single genre or mood, they freely explore new styles across vocals and performance, and that flexibility is their greatest strength.

TUNEXX, who say they feel happiest when locking eyes and connecting with fans on stage, now have their sights set on bigger stages beyond Korea. Taking the honor of being named a Billboard Up & Comer as powerful motivation, they hold bold ambitions that run from a first music show win to a world tour, and ultimately the top of the Billboard charts. Ready to make fresh waves in the global music scene through constant experimentation, TUNEXX share their story in their own words.
